skills.name: Hull Upgrades
skills.desc: Skill at maintaining your ship's armor and installing hull upgrades like expanded cargoholds and inertial stabilizers. Grants a 5% bonus to armor hit points per skill level.

skills.name: Mechanics
skills.desc: Skill at maintaining the mechanical components and structural integrity of a spaceship. 5% bonus to structure hit points per skill level.

skills.name: Repair Systems
skills.desc:
Operation of armor/hull repair modules. 5% reduction in repair systems duration per skill level.

Note: Has no effect on capital sized modules.

skills.name: Drone Avionics
skills.desc:
Skill at control range for all drones.

Bonus: Drone control range increased by 5000 meters per skill level.

skills.name: Drone Durability
skills.desc:
Increases drone and fighter hit points.

5% bonus to drone shield, armor and hull hit points per level.
5% bonus to fighter hit points per level.

skills.name: Drone Interfacing
skills.desc:
Improves damage and mining yield for drones and fighters under your control.

10% bonus to drone damage and drone mining yield per level.
10% bonus to fighter damage per level.

skills.name: Drone Navigation
skills.desc:
Skill at controlling drones at high speeds.

5% increase in drone max velocity per level.
5% increase in fighter max velocity per level.

skills.name: Drone Sharpshooting
skills.desc:
Increases the weapon range of drones and fighters.

5% bonus to drone optimal range per level.
5% bonus to fighter optimal range per level.

skills.name: Drones
skills.desc: Skill at remote controlling drones. Can operate 1 drone per skill level.

skills.name: Gallente Drone Specialization
skills.desc: Specialization in the operation of advanced Gallente drones. 2% bonus per skill level to the damage of light, medium, heavy and sentry drones requiring Gallente Drone Specialization.

skills.name: Light Drone Operation
skills.desc: Skill at controlling light combat drones. 5% bonus to damage of light drones per level.

skills.name: Electronic Warfare
skills.desc:
Operation of ECM jamming systems. 5% less capacitor need for ECM and ECM Burst systems per skill level.

Note: Does not affect capital class modules.

skills.name: Propulsion Jamming
skills.desc: Skill at using propulsion/warpdrive jammers. 5% Reduction to Warp Scrambler, Warp Disruptor, and Stasis Web capacitor need per skill level.

skills.name: Advanced Weapon Upgrades
skills.desc: Reduces the powergrid needs of weapon turrets and launchers by 2% per skill level.

skills.name: Capacitor Management
skills.desc: Skill at regulating your ship's overall energy capacity. 5% bonus to capacitor capacity per skill level.

skills.name: Capacitor Systems Operation
skills.desc: Skill at operating your ship's capacitor, including the use of capacitor boosters and other basic energy modules. 5% reduction in capacitor recharge time per skill level.

skills.name: CPU Management
skills.desc: Basic understanding of spaceship sensory and computer systems. 5% Bonus to ship CPU output per skill level.

skills.name: Power Grid Management
skills.desc: Basic understanding of spaceship energy grid systems. 5% Bonus to ship's powergrid output per skill level.

skills.name: Weapon Upgrades
skills.desc: Knowledge of gunnery computer systems, including the use of weapon upgrade modules. 5% reduction per skill level in the CPU needs of weapon turrets, launchers and smartbombs.

skills.name: Controlled Bursts
skills.desc: Allows better control over the capacitor use of weapon turrets. 5% reduction in capacitor need of weapon turrets per skill level.

skills.name: Gunnery
skills.desc: Basic turret operation skill. 2% Bonus to weapon turrets' rate of fire per skill level.

skills.name: Motion Prediction
skills.desc: Improved ability at hitting moving targets. 5% bonus per skill level to weapon turret tracking speeds.

skills.name: Rapid Firing
skills.desc: Skill at the rapid discharge of weapon turrets. 4% bonus per skill level to weapon turret rate of fire.

skills.name: Sharpshooter
skills.desc: Skill at long-range weapon turret firing. 5% bonus to weapon optimal range per skill level.

skills.name: Small Blaster Specialization
skills.desc: Specialist training in the operation of advanced small blasters. 2% bonus per skill level to the damage of small turrets requiring Small Blaster Specialization.

skills.name: Small Hybrid Turret
skills.desc: Operation of small hybrid turrets. 5% Bonus to small hybrid turret damage per level.

skills.name: Small Projectile Turret
skills.desc: Operation of small projectile turrets. 5% Bonus to small projectile turret damage per level.

skills.name: Surgical Strike
skills.desc: Knowledge of spaceships' structural weaknesses. 3% bonus per skill level to the damage of all weapon turrets.

skills.name: Trajectory Analysis
skills.desc: Advanced understanding of zero-G physics. 5% bonus per skill level to weapon turret accuracy falloff.

skills.name: Acceleration Control
skills.desc: Skill at efficiently using Afterburners and MicroWarpdrives. 5% Bonus to Afterburner and MicroWarpdrive speed boost per skill level.

skills.name: Afterburner
skills.desc: Skill at using afterburners. 5% reduction to Afterburner duration and 10% reduction in Afterburner capacitor use per skill level.

skills.name: Evasive Maneuvering
skills.desc: Improved skill at efficiently turning and accelerating a spaceship. 5% improved ship agility for all ships per skill level.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.desc: Skill at regulating the power output of ship thrusters. 5% bonus to sub-warp ship velocity per skill level.

skills.name: Science
skills.desc: Basic understanding of scientific principles. 5% Bonus to blueprint copying speed per level.

skills.name: Gallente Frigate
skills.desc: Skill at operating Gallente frigates.

skills.name: Minmatar Frigate
skills.desc: Skill at operating Minmatar frigates.

skills.name: Spaceship Command
skills.desc: The basic operation of spaceships. 2% improved ship agility for all ships per skill level.

skills.name: Long Range Targeting
skills.desc: Skill at long range targeting. 5% Bonus to targeting range per skill level.

skills.name: Signature Analysis
skills.desc: Skill at operating Targeting systems. 5% improved targeting speed per skill level.

skills.name: Target Management
skills.desc: Skill at targeting multiple targets. +1 extra target per skill level, up to the ship's maximum allowed number of targets locked.
